name: infotechtutoriais.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: infotechtutoriais.com scores 68 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Google consent message was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (1 request), Google Ads (9 requests), and cookies _ga_3N41GWLNZ5, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 69 elements on /, /category/free-fire/, /category/entretenimento/, for example .post-1581 > .mh-loop-content.mh-clearfix > .mh-loop-header > .mh-meta.mh-loop-meta > .mh-meta-date.updated and .post-1581 > .mh-loop-content.mh-clearfix >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 15 elements on /, /category/free-fire/, /category/entretenimento/, for example .wp-block-pages-list__item:nth-child(1) > .wp-block-pages-list__item__link and .wp-block-pages-list__item:nth-child(2) > .wp-block-pages-list__item__link.…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Do not consent" and reloading, Google Ads (9 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), and new cookies C on adform.net, uid on adform.net still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 30 elements on /, /category/free-fire/, /category/entretenimento/, for example .post-1581 > figure > a and .post-1579 > figure > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 714 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
